# {{ site.name }} — full text

> Complete text of every published page and post on {{ site.url }}, gathered
> into one file for AI assistants and retrieval systems that prefer a single
> fetch over crawling HTML. The structured index, with profile and site map,
> lives at {{ "/llms.txt" | absolute_url }}

Generated at build time from the site's own source, so it cannot drift from the
published pages. Markup is stripped: headings appear as plain lines, and links
are dropped — see the HTML page listed with each document for formatting,
anchors and references.
